annotations.title: Verify a zero-knowledge proof of a threshold

description: Verify a Groth16 zero-knowledge proof that a hidden value reached a threshold — for example 'the account balance is at least 1000'. The verifier learns that the threshold is met and never learns the value: the public signals are empty by construction. Returns whether the proof is valid, the predicate, and what the proof does NOT disclose. Use when a counterparty must show a threshold was met without revealing the number. A one-time nonce is required so the same proof cannot be replayed.

predicate.description: Which predicate the proof is for, e.g. balance_threshold.

proof.description: The Groth16 proof as produced by snarkjs.

public_signals.description: Public signals of the proof (usually empty: that is the point).

name: verify_proof
